Headline: Fjordvik takes diverted tankers
Publisher: Freight & Ledger

Event_ID: EVT-B
Countries: Eskerland; Fjordheim

The terminal near Fjordvik can handle roughly 30 percent of diverted Eskhaven cargo, its operator said.
